product_summary: Indian entity (heliospackaging.co.in, corporate office Plot 29/A, 4th Phase, KIADB Industrial Area, Malur, Kolar Dist., Karnataka; plants/branches also Sonipat (Haryana), Chennai, Pondicherry, Goa, Ahmedabad, Bangalore). Declared product range per own website: air bubble film; angle boards; composite packaging; corrugated cartons; EPE foam & fitments; foldable large containers (FLC); HDPE crates & bins; pallet sleeve boxes; polypropylene sheets & boxes; polyurethane foam & fitments; stretch film rolls; wooden pallets; pulp packaging; nailless plywood boxes; XLPE foam & fitments; plus packaging consumables (PET strap, static shielding bags, BOPP & floor marking tapes, silica gel sachets, aluminium bags, ziplock pouches). Site also claims 10 automated manufacturing units, flexo/rotogravure printing, extrusion lamination, SGS/Intertek audits.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared manufacturer with own plants; no independent corroboration of plant ownership in this check — declared, not confirmed). Trader signs: the 'packaging consumables' block (silica gel sachets, tapes, PET strap) reads as a resale/indent line rather than own production.
comment: HS 3923.90 is only partially right: it covers the plastic crates/bins, PP boxes and composite packaging, but the declared single code misses most of the actual range. Corrugated cartons (4819.10), wooden pallets (4415.20), nailless plywood boxes (4412/4415), moulded pulp packaging (4823.90) and stretch film/PP sheets in roll or sheet form (3920.10/3920.20) fall outside 3923.90 entirely — the declaration is under-scoped, not wrong in principle. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' (Construction & DIY) is a misclassification: the company is an industrial/transport packaging manufacturer (protective packaging, crates, pallets, foam fitments), not a construction-materials or DIY supplier. Correct industry: packaging / industrial packaging materials. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, code set corrected to the multi-code list above. All product lines are taken from the company's own website (https://www.heliospackaging.co.in/products/ and /contact-us/); no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task, therefore every product line is marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note: a similarly named Belgian sleeve-label converter (heliospackaging.com, Wommelgem, BE 0809.564.968) exists and must not be confused with this Indian entity. Revenue, export volumes, PAN/CIN and shipment history: null — not researched here.
